reason: Tabelle 89 (p.162) 'Bilanzierung Entsorgung Abzweigungen und Formstücke aus Stahl' is the disposal balance of steel branch connections and fittings — this dataset, per kg. Tabelle 88 on p.161 is the production counterpart (wrong direction) and Tabelle 93 (p.163) is the same disposal for stainless steel ('Edelstahl'), a different material. The range p.161-163 covers the introducing text and the neighbouring pages the table can run onto.
